jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
• Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
• Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
• Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
• Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
• Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
• Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
• Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
• Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
• Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

• Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
• Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
• Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
• Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
• Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
• Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
• Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
• Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
• Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
• Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.occupation: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply

• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar

jobs.occupation: Lead Consultant – Vulnerability Management; DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Can you translate complex technical security requirements into something the business understands and acts on - and challenge where necessary?

Energinet is seeking a highly skilled cyber security professional to join our Attack Surface Management team within the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the link between the department's technical specialists and the rest of Energinet and ensure that security requirements are both understood, prioritised and complied with.

You combine solid technical insight with clear communication and business understanding. You present innovative ideas with confidence, along with the presence and authority to guide decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the operation and continual improvement of enterprise vulnerability management capabilities across IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Build, maintain, and optimize vulnerability scanning infrastructure, configurations, policies, and workflows.
• Develop scalable vulnerability assessment processes covering infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud workloads, containers, and identities.
• Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and vulnerability visibility across the enterprise.
• Manage lifecycle vulnerability processes from detection through validation, prioritization, remediation, and closure.
• Establish metrics and performance indicators to measure remediation effectiveness and risk reduction outcomes.
• Analyze attack paths, exposure chains, and security control weaknesses that could contribute to organizational risk.
• Develop risk-based methodologies for prioritizing exposures based on exploitability, business criticality, threat intelligence, and operational impact.
• Support continuous assessment of the organization's security posture through exposure analytics and attack surface monitoring.
• Serve as the technical owner and subject matter expert for vulnerability and exposure management platforms.

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority.” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding in cyber and information security and can go in-depth with technical solutions.
• Have CISSP or an equivalent certification (e.g. CISM) - or are close to earning it.
• Is an effective communicator who can communicate complex requirements clearly to both technicians, project managers and management.
• Works in a structured way and projects professional authority.
• Have business understanding and the ability to question constructively and create progress.
• Be fluent in English at a high level in writing and speech. Danish proficiency is an advantage but not mandatory. 
About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management - a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface. 

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organizational processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. 

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

 English:

 Cleaning Assistant – 10–12 Hours per Week

RenTid is looking for a reliable and responsible Cleaning Assistant to join our team in Aarhus.

We are looking for a part-time employee for approximately 10–12 hours per week, with the work primarily consisting of commercial cleaning at our customers’ premises.

This position is especially well suited for a student looking to earn some extra money alongside their studies.

 Working Hours

The working hours will primarily be 3 to 4 days a week, and 2 to 4 hours per day, according to our customers’ needs.

It is a fixed requirement that you are available to work approximately 2 hours every Saturday. Therefore, you must be comfortable having Saturday work as a regular part of your schedule.

The total working time will be approximately 10–12 hours per week.

 Your Responsibilities

Your tasks will primarily include:

• 
Cleaning offices and commercial premises

• 
Vacuuming and mopping floors

• 
Cleaning toilets and common areas

• 
Dusting and wiping surfaces

• 
General cleaning and maintenance tasks

• 
Other cleaning-related tasks at our customers’ premises

You will receive proper training and an introduction to our working procedures and quality standards.

 We Are Looking for Someone Who

• 
Is reliable and punctual

• 
Is responsible and able to work independently

• 
Has an eye for detail and takes pride in doing a good job

• 
Is service-minded and professional when dealing with customers

• 
Is able to work approximately 2 hours every Saturday

• 
Is motivated to become part of a small company where quality and good service are important

• 
Speaks English 

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement if you have the right attitude and are willing to learn.

 We Offer

• 
Approximately 10–12 hours of work per week

• 
A flexible part-time job that fits well alongside studies

• 
Training and introduction to the job

• 
Varied tasks within commercial cleaning

• 
A good working environment in a small company

• 
Possibility of additional hours by agreement and depending on business needs

 About RenTid

RenTid is a professional cleaning company based in Aarhus, providing cleaning services to both businesses and private customers.

We place great importance on high quality, reliability and excellent customer service — and we expect the same from our employees.

 How to Apply

If you are interested in the position, please send us a short application telling us a little about yourself, your current situation and why you would like to work for RenTid. Write your application in English please  Mark the application "10 - 12 Hours".

We look forward to hearing from you!
